Markets.title: WACR tops repo rate for first time in nearly 2 months
Markets.summary: Banking sector liquidity dropped below ₹5 lakh crore, pushing the weighted average call rate up to 5.31% for the first time in nearly two months. Analysts expect liquidity to return to normal levels around ₹5 lakh crore by the end of the month as government spending and bond sales occur.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices faced pressure and closed lower on Tuesday as foreign investors sold shares while domestic investors bought. The Nifty is expected to continue trading within a broad consolidation range for today's session.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Adani Group, OMCs, Persistent Systems and IRB Infra
Markets.summary: Indian stocks closed lower on Tuesday due to profit-taking amid news affecting several major companies. Key market developments included Adani Group resolving SEBI issues, shifting focus to oil marketing firms following a drop in crude prices, and Persistent Systems expanding its stake in Nagarro.

Markets.title: Rupee strengthens to 95.59 amid drop in oil prices & RBI dollar sales
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened to 95.59 on Tuesday due to falling oil prices and dollar sales by the central bank. Despite corporate demand for dollars, this intervention helped the currency maintain its stability during the trading session.

Markets.title: September sees biggest IPO rush in nearly 30 years as 30 mainboard issues raise Rs 38,785 crore
Markets.summary: Thirty mainboard initial public offerings were launched in September, marking the largest IPO rush in nearly 30 years. These companies raised a total of Rs 38,785 crore during the month.

Markets.title: Nvidia's stock is flashing a warning sign as valuation drops
Markets.summary: Nvidia's stock is trading at less than 17 times its projected profit for the upcoming year, marking a decline from earlier 2025 and mid-2023 values. Investor confidence is wavering due to concerns over the sustainability of the company's earnings amid a broader rally in semiconductor shares.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials from both countries meet on sidelines
Geo-Political.summary: During his UN speech, US President Trump threatened to annihilate Iran while considering whether to take extreme action or pursue a peace deal. Simultaneously, officials from both the United States and Iran held meetings on the sidelines of the event.

Geo-Political.title: Burnham expects to find 'common ground' with Trump in first meeting
Geo-Political.summary: Prime Minister Burnham will meet with Donald Trump in New York to find common ground between their administrations. During the visit, Burnham is also scheduled to deliver a speech focused on artificial intelligence at the United Nations General Assembly.

Geo-Political.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
Geo-Political.summary: The United States and Denmark signed a defense deal at the UN General Assembly to build two new military bases in Greenland. The agreement also explicitly re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over the semi-autonomous Arctic territory.

Geo-Political.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
Geo-Political.summary: Morocco's upcoming election features campaigns targeting young voters through football slogans, job promises, and anti-Israel rhetoric. These political strategies are shaped by key geo-political issues involving Ceuta, sports diplomacy, and Israel.

Geo-Political.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over deadly Easter Sunday bombings
Geo-Political.summary: A Sri Lankan court has convicted 15 men for their involvement in the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings. The coordinated attacks targeted three churches and three luxury hotels, resulting in 270 deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Developing El Niño becomes strongest on record weeks before expected peak
Geo-Political.summary: Scientists report that the developing El Niño has become the strongest on record. Weather impacts from this climate pattern are already being felt globally weeks before its expected peak.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: Strong pace of economic growth seen in June quarter to continue, says FM
Data & Insights.summary: India's Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the strong economic growth seen in the June quarter will continue. She noted that the federal budget presented on February 1 will sustain this growth pace through 2026.

Data & Insights.title: Charges, framework, dedicated fund — How MDR on UPI works for micro and small merchants, explained
Data & Insights.summary: Starting October 15, a 0.4% merchant discount rate applies to person-to-merchant UPI transactions exceeding ₹2,000. This article explains how these charges, the new framework, and the dedicated fund work for micro and small merchants.

Data & Insights.title: Jamie Dimon flags India's 'inconsistent application of taxes': What the JPMorgan CEO said about Indian economy
Data & Insights.summary: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon criticized India's inconsistent application of tax regulations. Foreign investors have long raised concerns about these unpredictable policies alongside the country's relatively high taxes.

Data & Insights.title: Saudi oil shock could hit Asian refiners through prices and freight before crude runs out
Data & Insights.summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline has resumed operations after a shutdown that disrupted its crude export network. This restart has eased fears of a prolonged supply shortage for Asian refiners.

Data & Insights.title: FM asks entrepreneurs to build not just bigger, but better companies
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman urged corporate leaders to build an ecosystem where products are conceived, designed, developed, and manufactured in India for global markets. She encouraged entrepreneurs to focus on creating better companies rather than just larger ones.

Data & Insights.title: China has what Trump needs for AI race: Why Beijing’s rare earths may matter more than tariffs at Trump-Xi summit
Data & Insights.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping's upcoming talks highlight China's dominance over the global rare earths supply. This leverage is crucial for the U.S. artificial intelligence race as Washington actively seeks alternative sources, including Greenland.

India.title: Two Cops Found Dead Inside Car In Jammu And Kashmir
India.summary: Two policemen were found dead under suspicious circumstances inside a parked car in the Batote area of Jammu and Kashmir. The deceased have been identified as Head Constable Farid Ahmed and Selection Grade Constable Muhammad Yaqoob.

India.title: Man Shoots Wife, 2 Priests In UP's Azamgarh, Takes 2 Children Hostage
India.summary: A man in Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, shot and injured his wife and two priests. He then took his two children hostage and locked himself in a room while police attempted to rescue them.

India.title: 4 Months On, No FIR Yet In Vaishno Devi's Rs 550 Crore-Silver 'Scandal'
India.summary: Four months after a complaint alleged the pilferage and adulteration of Rs 550 crore in silver offerings at the Vaishno Devi shrine, authorities have not yet filed an FIR. Advocate Deepak Sharma filed the original complaint regarding the missing offerings made by devotees.

India.title: 'Need The Money Now': Rs 700-Crore Mylapore Fund Scam Victims Demand Fast-Track Justice
India.summary: Victims of the Rs 700-crore Mylapore Hindu Permanent Fund Nidhi scam are demanding fast-track justice for their lost money. Entrepreneur and politician Devanathan Yadav, who headed the fund, has been arrested in connection with the case.

India.title: Dance, Liquor Videos: Bihar Groping Horror Accused's Facebook Timeline
India.summary: Nandan Yadav is an accused in the Bihar groping horror incident. His Facebook timeline features multiple videos of him aggressively posing with friends and consuming alcohol.

India.title: Why Maharashtra Minister Has Warned Of A Potential 100% Drought Situation
India.summary: A Maharashtra minister has warned of a potential 100% drought situation in the state. Maharashtra has emerged as one of India's worst-hit states by the drought this September.

General.title: Trump says he can do business with Burnham but criticises 'terrible' Chagos deal
General.summary: Donald Trump stated he could work with UK politician Andy Burnham but strongly criticized the proposed agreement to transfer the Chagos Islands to Mauritius. Under this proposed deal, the UK plans to hand over the islands while paying to lease back a vital military base.

General.title: Watch: Burnham 'gets it' says Trump, as the two leaders meet for first time
General.summary: Donald Trump met with Andy Burnham in New York for their first face-to-face meeting and stated that he can do business with him. During the meeting, Trump also criticized the Chagos Islands agreement, calling it "terrible."

General.title: Plot targeting Manchester's Jewish community disrupted, say police
General.summary: Counter-terrorism police in Manchester arrested two men on Sunday. The arrests were made to disrupt a planned plot targeting the local Jewish community.

General.title: 'Poison seller' who sold my daughter deadly drugs should rot in hell
General.summary: Louise Nunn's daughter died after purchasing toxic chemicals online from Canadian seller Kenneth Law. Nunn stated that Law should rot in hell for selling the deadly drugs.

General.title: IMF tells advanced economies to 'bring debt down' as borrowing costs rise
General.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva urged advanced economies to reduce their high debt levels as borrowing costs continue to rise. She noted that recent economic shocks have caused government debt to increase significantly.

General.title: Booker Prize judges reveal shortlisted novels after selection 'tussle'
General.summary: Judges for the Booker Prize have announced the shortlisted novels for this year's award following a competitive selection process. Past winners Marlon James and Douglas Stuart are included among the nominees.
